subject: [PATCH 48/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to reclaim-capable memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original patch author posted a duplicate message with no changes or discussion.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts the reclaim advice to only common memory nodes, introducing a new function `folio_allows_reclaim()` that checks if a folio's node permits reclaim. The changes are made in various files related to madvise and huge pages.
